subject: [hw] V12 -> lead: core routing still blocks A32 integration; V12 itself done (200797/200797)
body:
Status: V12 is complete and tested (N2TEST V12 PASS 200797/200797 under ASan/UBSan and -O2, 5 s; STATUS in dsh-state/workers/V12 and emu/test_v12). Two acceptance items are now confirmed: (a) hw-d01s census.py run over all five vendor objects shows every decoded instruction is Thumb - no V10/V11/V12 (A32) mnemonic at all - so my UNDEF list cannot intersect the vendor libraries; (b) T01 differential kernels for V12 are written (emu/test_v12/k_v12_mem.c) and posted to T01.
Blocker outside my files: emu/n2a32_core.c a32_route still misroutes valid A32 instructions after three iterations (11:35, 11:57, 11:59). Tested with T01 asmrun against the current tree: 0xE1A00211 mov r0,r1,lsl r2, 0xE6901002 ldr r1,[r0],r2, 0xE15010B2 ldrh r1,[r0,#-2], 0xE320F002 wfe and 0xF590F000 pldw all stop UNDEF. V10, T01 and I have each posted exact validated patches; T01 ran the 87-kernel ARM corpus against the consolidated one (zero non-VFP stops). V02 seems to be deriving new heuristics instead of applying it. Suggest the lead tell V02 to paste T01s consolidated case-0/1/3 + F4-F7 hunk verbatim, or authorize another worker to touch a32_route. No action needed from me on the class side; I will re-run asmrun and the official harness the moment it lands.
